passages.section: Types of Micro Irrigation Systems under PDMC / Drip Irrigation System

metadata.title: Key to Common Problems of Tomatoes
metadata.geographic_scope: General tomato symptom screening and growing practices.
metadata.review_notes: General symptom patterns and prevention practices. Excludes geographically specific prevalence or treatment.

passages.section: Symptoms on Leaves and Stems, Leaf Yellowing and Leaf Spots
passages.content: Yellow margins can surround some leaf spots. Yellowing between veins can indicate a nutrient problem. Yellow lower leaves with wilting can be associated with wilt disease.

passages.section: Symptoms on fruits - blotches or discolored areas, Blossom end rot
passages.content: A dark, leathery depression at the blossom end can indicate blossom-end rot. Calcium can be insufficient in growing fruit tissue under stress such as irregular or shallow irrigation. Maintain steady watering and mulch, and check soil pH before amending.

metadata.title: Tomato leaf spot diseases
metadata.review_notes: Approved general sanitation and moisture-management practices only. No chemical treatment recommendation.

passages.content: Water the soil at the base of plants, cover soil with mulch to reduce splashing, support plants for airflow, and handle plants after the foliage dries.

metadata.title: Organic Farming Practices – Okra Disease Management
metadata.geographic_scope: General okra symptoms and preventive practices described for India.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed observable symptoms and non-chemical precautions. Excluded treatment recipes and loss estimates.

passages.content: A conspicuous network of yellow, thickened veins and veinlets is a sign associated with yellow vein mosaic in okra (bhindi, lady's finger). In severe cases young leaves are small and yellow, plants are stunted, and fruits may be small or misshapen.

passages.section: Yellow vein mosaic, Symptoms and Management
passages.content: Remove weeds and other wild host plants where possible. The guide lists Arka Anamika and Arka Abhay among okra varieties reported to tolerate yellow vein mosaic, without claiming complete resistance.

metadata.title: ICT-AAS: Brinjal Crop Protection
metadata.geographic_scope: General brinjal identification and cultural measures. No local prevalence or dates.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed signs and non-chemical practices only. Excluded legacy products, dosages, and trap rates.

passages.content: Brinjal (eggplant) seedlings with damping-off may turn pale green and develop brown lesions where the stem meets the soil, then collapse. For prevention in nurseries, prepare raised seedbeds and avoid standing water.

passages.section: Fruit and shoot borer, Symptoms and Management
passages.content: Brinjal (eggplant) shoots may wilt when fruit and shoot borer larvae tunnel inside. Infested fruits can have boreholes plugged with larval waste. The guide recommends hand-removing affected shoots and fruits from the field and locating nurseries away from infested crop residues.

Knots or galls on the roots of stunted brinjal (eggplant) are consistent with root-knot nematode damage. Yellowing may accompany stunting. Cultural measures listed include removing crop roots and stubble after harvest, controlling weed hosts, and rotating with crops that do not host the nematode.

metadata.title: Crop Protection: Onion Thrips
metadata.geographic_scope: General onion thrips identification and cultural practices.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed symptoms and regular hoeing. Excluded irrigation and chemical interventions.

passages.section: Symptoms of damage, Identification of pest, and Management
passages.content: Small silvery-white patches on onion leaves can indicate thrips. Under heavy infestation leaves may dry downward from their tips. Adult onion thrips range in colour from pale yellow to grey. The guide includes keeping the field clean and hoeing regularly as cultural management practices.

metadata.title: Tomato Cultural Practices
metadata.geographic_scope: General cultural practices with explicit variety and hybrid restrictions.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed cultivar-specific spacing and staking for hybrid tomatoes. Excluded pesticide, fertilizer and growth-regulator rates.

passages.content: For hybrid tomatoes, the guide recommends staking about 30 days after planting with stakes 1 to 1.5 m tall. The guide links staking to easier harvest and better fruit yield and quality.
Choose planting spacing for the specific tomato variety. The guide lists 60 × 45 cm for TNAU Tomato Hybrid CO 3 and 45 × 30 cm for the variety CO 3. These spacings apply to the cited cultivars.

metadata.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Agritech Portal (Centre for Indian Knowledge Systems, Chennai)
metadata.title: Organic Farming Practices: Tomato Cultivation
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed the cultural weed management guidance and the caution on deep cultivation.

passages.content: Weed competition can sharply reduce tomato yield, and weeds are especially important early in crop growth. The guide describes manual weeding and frequent shallow hoeing in the first four weeks after transplanting. Deep cultivation can injure tomato roots.

metadata.title: ICT-AAS: Tomato
metadata.geographic_scope: General tomato soil suitability and soil testing before the crop season.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed soil suitability and soil testing purpose. Excluded local planting calendars, yield figures and amendment rates.

passages.content: Tomato grows well in well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter. Highly acidic soil is unsuitable. Arrange a soil test at the beginning of the crop season.

metadata.publisher: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University Agritech Portal (Centre for Indian Knowledge Systems, Chennai)
metadata.title: Organic Farming Practices: Tomato Water Requirements
metadata.geographic_scope: General tomato crop water management for growth and fruit set.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed even moisture for fruit set and cracking prevention. Excluded fixed irrigation intervals and input recipes.

passages.content: Maintaining an even water supply supports tomato growth and fruit set. A dry period followed by a sudden heavy watering can cause fruit cracking.

metadata.title: ICAR Rabi Agro-Advisory for Farmers 2021–22
metadata.geographic_scope: Published crop durations for three named potato varieties. General guidance for interpreting maturity.
metadata.review_notes: Reviewed the variety descriptions in the potato section. Excluded yield figures and seasonal or district schedules.

passages.section: Rabi Vegetables — Potato, Early Varieties (printed page 149)
passages.content: ICAR describes the duration for three early potato varieties: 70–90 days for Kufri Pukhraj, 75–80 days for Kufri Ashoka, and 90–100 days for Kufri Surya. The range across these examples is 70–100 days.
